faq.title:
Frequently asked

questions.
faq.contact: Not here? <link>Write to us</link> and we’ll help.

processing.q: How long does it take to process a video?
processing.a: It depends on the file’s length, size and quality. You can follow progress in your projects and review clips when processing finishes.

fileFormats.a: You can upload common formats such as MP4, MOV, WebM and MKV, or import a supported link. Maximum file size and duration depend on your plan.

faces.q: Does the vertical reframe cut off faces?
faces.a: Automatic tracking aims to keep the speaker in frame. Always review the result and adjust the crop in the editor when needed. This feature depends on your plan.

editCaptions.a: Yes. You can review and correct the transcript before exporting. Available styles, translation and the name dictionary depend on your plan.

afterCancel.q: What happens to my videos if I cancel?
afterCancel.a: If you cancel a paid plan, its features remain available until the current billing period ends. Download anything you need before your plan’s storage period expires.

publish.q: Does Clipealo publish to my networks for me?
publish.a: Yes. Connect your accounts and choose where each clip goes. Available channels and scheduling depend on your plan.
